name: Bounty Hounds Online
summary: Fight to maintain peace and be a hero in Bounty Hounds Online - a free-to-play, sci-fi MMORPG set in the vast world of Clear Sky. You will assume the role of a mercenary that aims to keep the peace after a massive galactic war against aliens. Choose from five unique classes, each with their own strengths, weaknesses, and abilities, and wield an array of sci-fi weapons. The game also has an in-depth crafting and pet system. Pets are called CTUs, or Combat Tactical Units which can fight alongside you in battles. Participate in team battlegrounds or 1v1 arenas to acquire awesome PvP gear and prestige.
